Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter where action_type equals 'BLOCKER' and max_phase equals 4. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
